title: Nobody at MettleUp is warned when AI column matching nears or hits its daily ceiling
what: AI column matching in the member import allows 20 reads a gym and 1,000 for all gyms together each India day. When a gym or all gyms reach the ceiling the server quietly refuses without even a log line, and HQ only lists past use per gym. There is no warning as the shared ceiling gets close, so on a busy import day every owner silently falls back to matching by hand and MettleUp does not find out.
expected: HQ warns when the shared daily ceiling passes about 80 percent, and each time a gym or all gyms hit the ceiling it is counted and shown so the limit can be raised.
how_often: on days with many imports, or after abuse
fix_line: Count refusals at the ceiling and show a warning in HQ before and when the daily ceiling is reached

title: An owner who used up today's AI matches is only told the AI was not available
what: The server answers with a clear reason when today's AI matches are used up, but the import screen shows the same line for every failure: matched without AI because it was not available. The owner does not learn that it will work again tomorrow, and may re-upload the file hoping for AI.
expected: When the day's limit is the reason, the line says today's AI matches are used up and they come back tomorrow.
how_often: each import after the day's limit
fix_line: Show a separate line for the daily-limit case
